whenToUse: Choosing between rooms, spaces, tables or vehicles whose capacity depends on a layout or arrangement.
Showing at a glance which options fit a head count, and why the others do not.
avoidWhen: Capacity does not vary by layout and there are only a few options — a filter on a plain list is enough.
Booking a time slot — use scheduler or calendar components.
a11y: The layout switch is a toggle group with roving focus; the count is a slider with a synced, labelled number field.
The summary is a polite live region and each option states its status in text, not only colour.
